summary: Specifies the steps a host takes to configure its own IPv6 addresses automatically on an interface. It lets a host form addresses without a server handing them out. It was a draft standard, replaced by RFC 4862.

eli5.summary: A computer can make up its own address by combining a local street name with something unique to itself, so nobody has to hand it one.
